description: Returns a one-time link, valid for five minutes, where the person reviews the offers and sets up payment on Plain. The person must open and confirm it. Setting up payment does not accept the offers or charge money. Use the same authorized connection that created the offers and keep the target company selected; continuationToken may then be omitted.

inputSchema.description: Requests a link for the person to review the offers and set up payment on Plain.

name: get_onboarding_payment_link

outputSchema.description: A browser link to Plain where the person reviews and signs the offers.

url.description: One-time link to open in the person's browser. Valid for five minutes.

title: Get the link to sign on Plain
